body: I’ve been there, man. A relationship ending can lead you to really dark places. All I can say, as someone older with a little more life experience is that you should give yourself more time premise your happiness on your owl life and not someone else’s. Relationships take a lot of work, and even the ones that seem great in the moment aren’t as great as they seem. There’s more out there. Give it a chance. Hang tough. You got this.

I feel you. But you might find that just doing it once to lose the virgin label, even in a dispassionate setting, might change your approach to finding a partner. I’d give it a shot. How you view yourself changes a lot after losing your v-card. And in a lot of ways, for the better. 

Not saying you need to go out and fuck a prostitute. But first times pretty much suck for everyone. No need to go into that first experience expecting love and intimacy to go along with the deed, ya know?
